name: Fiche example — funding contrarian (fade crowded-short capitulation, long spot)
rationale: A minimal, worked funding-contrarian reference (paired with the authoring fiche, docs/AUTHORING.md). Mechanism: perpetual funding is a crowding gauge — DEEPLY NEGATIVE funding means shorts are paying longs, i.e. the market is positioned net-short and crowded into the down-side. That crowding mean-reverts: a short squeeze / capitulation bottom tends to follow extreme-negative funding, so a long-spot entry fades the crowded short. We require funding below a fitted NEGATIVE floor (crowded short) AND an oversold RSI below a fitted floor (price already washed out, not still falling), to avoid catching a knife in a clean down-trend. Exit: funding normalizes back above a fitted ceiling (the crowd has unwound — edge gone) or the stop/take/time-stop fires. The funding_feature wires the point-in-time funding rate as P&L accrual on the open position in the BACKTEST physics (paper/live trade the plain single stop/take — funding accrual is backtest-only today; see the SKILL toolbox matrix). No magic numbers — every threshold is a ParamRef in param_space.
catalyst: Deeply negative funding = crowded shorts paying longs; an oversold wash-out mean-reverts up as shorts capitulate.
